title: Attack Triangle Sequence: Phase 1
description: F1 leaves without the puck, cuts across the neutral zone and receives a pass in stride from the first player in the other line, then drives wide around the cones and shoots. After making the pass, the first player in the other line repeats the same sequence.

steps.name: Cut across the neutral zone
steps.notes: F1 leaves without the puck and cuts across the neutral zone.

steps.name: Pass in stride
steps.notes: The first player in the other line passes to F1 as F1 crosses centre ice. No stopping.

steps.name: Drive wide
steps.notes: F1 receives the pass in stride and carries the puck wide around the cones.

steps.name: Shoot
steps.notes: F1 drives wide and shoots. After passing, the first player in the other line repeats the sequence.
